17it1wk.description_en:
The storms over at [LOCATION] are getting to be a real pain in the ass. One of our outposts got absolutely reamed yesterday and needs some serious repairs so we're looking for help.
Figure you'd need to bring about six fuses, a salvaging tool, and enough RMC canisters to deal with at most eight busted pipes. We think that’ll cover, but you'll get exact numbers on site.
Hell with this place.
Hopefully you know what you're doing, but just in case, that “Guide to Maintenance” in your mobiGlas Journal might be worth a look.
Stows out.
17it1wk.description_zh:
<EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 那边的风暴真是要命，昨天我们一个前哨站被彻底摧毁了，需要大修，所以来找帮手。

估计你得带 <EM4>六个保险丝</EM4>、<EM4>打捞工具</EM4>，还有 <EM4>足够处理最多八根破裂管道的 RMC 罐</EM4>。我们觉得应该够用，但具体数量得到现场确认。

这破地方真见鬼。

希望你知道该怎么做，不过以防万一，你 mobiGlas 日志里的 <EM4>《维修指南》</EM4> 或许值得翻翻。

斯托斯通讯完毕。

1nmkhnj.description_en:
Got a big job for a big player. We’re in the process of making someone disappear, like completely vanish, and a part of that is recovering the blackbox from the “accident” that they had recently over at [LOCATION].
Only problem is, seems the people this person hired to stage the accident have gotten it in their heads that there’s more money to be made. So much so that they’re still keeping tabs on the now deceased’s ship.
These guys aren’t playing around either. You’ll need a couple of friends to help you do this. But if you can get the blackbox out of there and into our hands by dropping it at [DESTINATION], we can really make it worth your while.
-Bit Zeros

这帮人可不讲武德，你最好带俩帮手，不然分分钟凉透。但只要你能把黑匣子搞出来，送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4>，咱保证让你赚得盆满钵满。

1g9jltc.description_en:
Congrats on completing part five of this eight-part course.
I’m bringing out the big guns for scenario six. Time for you to go up against larger, multi-crewed ships, which provide a few new challenges. Not only will you have to contend with their enhanced firepower but their multifaceted shields means you’ll have to target one shield face continually to do real damage. Easier said than done when both of y’all are moving at such fast speeds.
Find your way to [LOCATION] whenever you're ready.
As a bonus, successful completion of the scenario will net the original contractor holder an award of 14 MG Scrip.
TRICKS OF THE TRADE:
- Size Advantage – When going up against a larger ship, try to stay away from their front as typically this is where the majority of their offensive fire is located.
Good luck out there,
Instructor Gilly
ABOUT GILLY’S FLIGHT SCHOOL
Instructor Lucas “Gilly” Baramsco has served in six squadrons and has over ten years of teaching experience. Whether a student with zero flight experience or a professional looking to polish their skills, Gilly Flight School offers a variety of courses to “Launch Your Piloting Career.”
1g9jltc.description_zh:
恭喜完成八节课程的第五部分。

场景 6 要动真格了——你将面对大型多船员飞船。这些巨兽带来全新挑战：不仅要应付凶猛火力，其多面护盾系统更要求你持续攻击同一面护盾才能造成有效伤害。在高速机动中保持精准攻击可不容易。

准备就绪后，请前往 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 开始训练。

作为奖励，成功完成该场景后，原始合约持有人将获得 <EM4>[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个雇佣兵公会凭证</EM4>。

实战技巧：
- 尺寸优势 - 对抗大型飞船时，尽量避开正前方，那里通常是主武器集中区域

祝你好运，
教练吉利

关于吉利飞行学院
教练卢卡斯·“吉利”·巴拉姆斯科曾在六个飞行中队服役，拥有超过十年的教学经验。无论是零飞行经验的学生，还是希望提升技能的专业人士，吉利飞行学院都提供多种课程，帮助“开启你的飞行生涯”。

itmsgo.description_en:
Hi,
Another day another beacon. There's a [SHIP] looking to be topped up with [FUELTYPE] at [LOCATION]. The client vessel will pay you at the rate of [REFUELREQUEST], and as a United Wayfarers Club contractor, you will also qualify for the UWC service fee listed above upon completion.

Maybe I'm being paranoid, but that doesn't mean they're not out to get you, as Momma Deloit used to say.

Just do the job and get home safe, okay?

1uosw4e.description_en:
Hey El here,
Got a weird one for you. I was checking the delivery stats for the past week and noticed some discrepancies. Seems we have a couple of deliveries marked as fulfilled but the cargo trackers are still showing as active.
One of these is located at [LOCATION] so I was hoping you could fly over and get to the bottom of this. The order says the hauler was using a ship that could carry [MAX_SCU] cargo containers so make sure you have the same. A heavy-duty tractor beam is a must for this one too.
That cargo needs to be delivered yesterday, so as soon as you've got it take it to a freight elevator at [DESTINATION] and I'll get your payment sorted for you.
Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Ella Tieno
Jr. Logistics Coordinator
Covalex Shipping
'Anything you need, anywhere you need it.'
Covalex Shipping is a limited liability corporation. To encourage timely deliveries and prevent fraud on cargo hauls, Covalex Shipping will set a delivery time limit and upon expiration, any undelivered cargo will be considered stolen and treated as such. Total payment will be prorated according to the percentage of cargo successfully delivered.

嘿，我是艾拉，

碰上个怪事，跟你讲一下。我刚核对了上周的送货记录，发现几单对不上。系统显示已签收，可集装箱的追踪器还亮着呢，说明货根本没到。

其中一单就在 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4>，你方便过去瞅瞅到底咋回事不？订单写明原承运飞船能装下 <EM4>[MAX_SCU] 尺寸的集装箱</EM4>，你得开同规格的船去；另外这活儿必须带上<EM4>重型牵引光束</EM4>，别省这一步。

这批货早就该送到了，你一拿到手就赶紧送到 <EM4>[DESTINATION]</EM4> 的货运电梯那儿，我立马给你把报酬安排上。

[SIGN_OFF]

艾拉·蒂埃诺
初级物流协调员
科瓦莱什货运
“尽你所需，达你所在。”

r4p35b.description_en:
A squad of ships recently shanked one of our convoys, and ten credits says they’re gonna try and do it again. Looking for someone to launch a reprisal attack before that can happen.
We’ve ID’d the idiots as consisting of several large craft and a sizable escort. We believe the leader is flying a [TARGET] and set that ship as the primary target. Since it’s a sizable and aggressive squad, a surprise attack seems like a smart play. They often pass by [LOCATION], which has an emission cloud to hide in. Be smart and patient then strike when the time is right.
Unless you fancy yourself a real ace, it’s probably best to bring some friends. Maybe you can entice folks by letting them know they can pick through the wreckage for valuables once the deed is done.
And on top of that, I'll give the main contractor a bonus 8 Council Scrip to sweeten the pot.
Stows out.

有一队飞船最近劫了我们的运输舰队，我赌十块钱他们还会再来。想找人在那之前给他们给他们点颜色看看。

已经确认这帮蠢货由几艘大船和一艘护卫舰组成。领队开的是 <EM4>[TARGET]</EM4>，就把它定为首要目标。既然对方人多势众又穷凶极恶，搞突袭才是上策。他们常经过 <EM4>[LOCATION]</EM4> 那片带辐射云的星域——藏好身形，伺机而动。

除非你自认是王牌飞行员，否则最好带几个帮手。不妨告诉来帮忙的人，干完这票可以在可以在残骸里随便捡值钱货。

更重要的是，我还会额外奖励给主承包商 <EM4>[SCRIPAMOUNT] 个堂会凭证</EM4> 作为甜头。

- 斯托斯

Thanks in advance for ensuring prompt service,
Chase Hewitt
